build_octconv_layer: build an MXNet Octave Convolution layer with high and low frequency filter groups
build_batchnorm_layer: build an MXNet BatchNorm layer with optional zero-initialized gamma for octave symbols
build_conv_bn_act_block: build a Convolution-BatchNorm-Activation block for octave convolution networks using Conv_BN_ACT
build_fullyconnected_octave: build an octave-aware FullyConnected layer that routes high and low frequency features
build_elementwise_sum_concat: build an ElementWiseSum or Concat operation across high and low frequency symbol tuples
